allow.reason: False positive: the 'nene-serve-dev-secret' literal IS the fail-closed guarded dev secret — it is passed as GuardedJwtSecretResolver's devSecret: constructor argument (line ~426, #136/#138), which refuses it in production (ADR 0013). The D1 rule only exempts the GuardedJwtSecretResolver::fromConfig() factory form, not the constructor/named-argument form serve uses, so it flags this sanctioned pattern.
